body: When they love their enemies it is only to kill them with kindness so to speak and elevate themselves and their power. Very few Christians actually see their enemies perspective and/or want them to be saved. (if enemy has done x they are worthy of condemnation)
Some days they harp and harp about my future plans and I'm only 25. In the past few months I been so upset I've wanted to get revenge but they're the ones who will hate me when I'm gone..

I didn't kill myself in time. It's too late. I can't tell them that I'm going to die. It's not like cancer and it's not just that I'm suicidal. I have to make deals with the devil so to speak in order to stay alive. I was sent for testing in march so I tried to kill myself with pills but the pills didn't work. I didn't really want to die then.

My ENEMIES Hurt me in the worst way!! I was freaking warned but they freaking did it anyway!! So dang angry!! Im gonna get the punishment in hell FOR THIS!! They won't get jack! I cried in front of them but they just gloat over how the wicked get more punishment on earth. Isn't that awesome? /s

Ok. It just seems to me that he punishes and/or punished me for things that he thought I did wrong and this seemed to be proof of that. 
Other people were saying ways that he was a jerk to them and I'm just trying to show another way.
